```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Exercise 1 — Worst condition
```{r ex1}
cond_means <- df %>%
  group_by(condition_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(BC_yield_gL), .groups = "drop")
worst <- cond_means %>% filter(mean_yield == min(mean_yield))
df %>% filter(condition_id == worst$condition_id) %>% slice(1) %>%
  select(pH, Temp_C, RPM, Inoculum_pct, Sugar_gL) %>% print()
cat(sprintf("Worst mean yield: %.3f g/L\n", worst$mean_yield))
```

## Exercise 2 — Cost of brute force
```{r ex2}
n_cond <- 10^10
ms_per <- 1
total_sec <- n_cond * ms_per / 1000
cat(sprintf("10^10 conditions\n"))
cat(sprintf("At 1 ms each: %.1e seconds = %.1f years\n", total_sec, total_sec / (365.25 * 86400)))
```

## Exercise 3 — Top 10
```{r ex3}
top10 <- cond_means %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_yield)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  left_join(df %>% filter(replicate == 1) %>% select(condition_id, pH, Temp_C, RPM, Inoculum_pct, Sugar_gL),
            by = "condition_id")
print(top10)
```

## Exercise 4 — Faceted heatmap
```{r ex4, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
df %>%
  group_by(pH, Sugar_gL, RPM, Inoculum_pct) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(BC_yield_gL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(RPM_Inoc = paste("RPM", RPM, "| Inoc", Inoculum_pct)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pH, y = Sugar_gL, fill = mean_yield)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~RPM_Inoc, ncol = 5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(x = "pH", y = "Sugar (g/L)", fill = "Yield") +
  theme_minimal()
```
